questions.question: Discuss the concept of heritage and examine its role in preserving cultural / identity.
questions.solution_html:
• Concept of Heritage
  • ● Includes tangible (monuments, buildings) and intangible (traditions, festivals), Passed
  • from past to present
  • Role in Cultural Identity
  • ● Preserves traditions and customs, builds national pride, promotes unity, educates future
  • generations, Maintains cultural continuity
  • Conclusion: Heritage is essential for preserving identity and cultural values.
questions.final_answer: Conclusion: Heritage is essential for preserving identity and cultural values

questions.question: Explain the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, / 1958 and its significance in heritage tourism management.
questions.solution_html:
• its significance in heritage tourism management.
  • About the Act
  • ● Protects ancient monuments and archaeological sites in India, Managed by ASI
  • (Archaeological Survey of India)
  • Key Provisions
  • ● Declares protected monuments, restricts construction near sites, Provides conservation
  • measures, Punishment for damage
  • Significance in Tourism
  • ● Ensures preservation of heritage sites, promotes sustainable tourism, attracts tourists
  • Maintains historical value
questions.final_answer: Maintains historical value
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
